we have shown that activation functions can play a key role in improving the quality of deep features, and can be trained jointly with the rest of the CNN parameters, leading to a more robust instance image retrieval system.
our ACTNET architecture achieves the state of the art results for instance image retrieval from a variety of large scale datasets.

the choice of activation function is a key factor for effective deep instance retrieval.
